results.name: Peter Voulkos, 1962, #1

user.displayName: Ohio State University Art and Design

results.description:
A work by [Peter Voulkos (Panagiotis Voulkos)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Peter_Voulkos) from 1962, from the [Arthur E. Baggs Memorial Library](https://u.osu.edu/ceramics/arthur-e-baggs-memorial-library/) in the Department of Art.
 
Captured with a single Canon EOS camera and processed/edited in Agisoft Photoscan by Jayne Kennedy and Jasmine Rajavadee.

This scan was produced in 2017 the 3D scanning lab, created and run by Andrew Frueh, in the Department of Art at The Ohio State University.
